notes.title: Steam leaderboard
notes.notes: Hey ! We've added a steam leaderboard so you don't need to type your name for each new score now ! Additionally, we've done a complete code rework for better performance but the gameplay stays the same. have fun guys !

notes.title: Achievements !
notes.notes: No we are not dead. Try to complete the game and loose your mind. Of course some of them are hidden so good luck ;)

notes.title: Settings update
notes.notes:
We added settings that include volume and sensitivity slider.

The FPS are not limited to 300.

You can also skip the splash screen.

Have fun ;)
